sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Try ACTION7 to see if it opens a passage or changes layout
result = action(['ACTION7'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
player = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'b'][0]
pc = [p[1] for p in player['boundary']]
pr = [p[0] for p in player['boundary']]
print(f"After ACTION7: player cols {min(pc)}-{max(pc)}, rows {min(pr)}-{max(pr)}")

greens = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Green blocks: {len(greens)}")

# Check adjacency
adj = seg['adjacency_list']
print(f"Player adjacencies:")
for a, b in adj:
    if a == player['id'] or b == player['id']:
        other_id = b if a == player['id'] else a
        other = seg['nodes'][other_id]
        print(f"  Adjacent to {other['color']} (id={other_id}, pixels={other['pixels']})")

print(f"Level completed: {result.get('level_completed')}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
